review: Independent read-only scientific/presentation calculation review; no model refits or source edits. Only this audit receipt written.
checks: All 18 model comparisons: matched test folds, AUROC/AP weighted by actual held-out fold sizes
Fixed 10%/20% score-only budgets per fold with ceil and whole boundary ties; no label-based cutoff selection
All budget TP/FP/selected counts independently recomputed
Family bootstrap matches sklearn sample-weight AUROC for 2 complete 1000-resample cases and explicit ties
Code inspection: no fitting, threshold optimization or molecular computations; confidence/energy directionality explicit
limitations: Budgets are post-hoc diagnostic choices relative to prior inspected test outcomes, not original prespecified evaluation endpoints.
Whole ties may exceed requested fraction; actual selected counts are reported. Model E has equal 77 selected at20%.
Fixed-prediction family bootstrap does not include training variability; sparse positive-family support limits precision.
Matched mean AUROC equivalence is not causal proof of a prevalence effect.
Raw whole-cohort descriptor AUROC is descriptive and not learned-model held-out performance.
